headline: CHW @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.58 at SFG 4.53, with a projected total of 9.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: CHW moved +0.12 runs while SFG moved +0.32, changing the projected margin by -0.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.45, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bryan Hudson has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Jung Hoo Lee, Willy Adames, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colson Montgomery because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
